messages:
Jamie: Hey team — POC with SparrowTech is failing on the embeddings -> rerank flow. Root error: dims mismatch on rerank and occasional 429s. Can we swarm for a quick triage?
Marta: On it. Which embed model are they using and any sample payload/logs?
Jamie: They say they're using our JS SDK default but pasted this server log: "Invalid vector length: expected 1536, got 1535". Also when they pushed concurrency they hit HTTP 429: "Rate limit exceeded".
Kevin: Two likely things: either the client produced a truncated vector (off-by-one) when serializing, or a post-processing step removed a value. Another angle: different embed model or tokenization change.
Kevin: Can you paste the raw JSON sent to /v1/embeddings and the model header?
Jamie: Pasted snippet from their logs: "{"model":"redwood-embed-1536-v1","input":[...],"vectors":[[...1535 floats...]]}"
Marta: If the HTTP model header is redwood-embed-1536-v1 but vectors are 1535 that's a client bug. Common culprits: using a Python list of arrays with inconsistent dtype, or accidentally slicing when converting to list.
Kevin: Quick repro check (python):
```
vec = np.asarray(your_vec, dtype=np.float32)
assert vec.shape[0] == 1536, "wrong dim: %s" % vec.shape
payload = vec.tolist()
```
Also check JS: make sure Float32Array.length === 1536 before JSON.stringify.
SRE-bot: @channel Observed burst of 429s on POST /v1/embeddings from ip 35.224.x.x correlated with SparrowTech client around 1765432123. See rate-limits dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/rate-limits/poctriage/abc123 :eyes:
Marta: For immediate unblock you can pad with 0.0 to 1536 (temporary workaround) so rerank accepts the vector. Not ideal but buys time.
Kevin: Also ensure rerank call uses the same embed model (dimensions must match). Our reranker only accepts 1536-dim vectors for the current model.
Jamie: Customer also asked about throughput pricing if we suggest burst or Dedicated for higher QPS.
Marta: For sustained QPS we recommend Redwood Dedicated. For short-term spikes, we can offer a burst commit. I'll pull numbers from SalesOps.
Eva: FYI we got a security questionnaire from the customer asking about data residency and audit logs. If we spin up Dedicated trial we need to capture region and policy. I'll work on the template response.
Jamie: Next steps to unblock?
Kevin: 1) Send exact failing payload and client snippet that constructs vectors. 2) Try padding test to 1536 to confirm rerank acceptance. 3) Reduce batch_size to 8 and max_concurrent to 4 to avoid 429s while we investigate. 4) If they need sustained throughput, propose Dedicated trial.
Marta: I'll open a Dedicated trial request and cc SalesOps for pricing.
Jamie: Sending payload now (DMing the file). Thanks! :thumbsup:
SRE-bot: Created incident ticket INF-1122 and attached logs / rate heatmap.
Marta: Updated the POC tracker with the ticket and security note for Eva.
Eva: I'll draft a short answer for the questionnaire re: residency, KMS, and audit retention and post it here.
Kevin: If folks want a small validator to run locally: 
```
# validator.py
import json, numpy as np
vec = json.load(open('vec.json'))  # expecting list of floats
arr = np.array(vec, dtype=np.float32)
print('shape', arr.shape)
if arr.shape[0] != 1536:
    raise SystemExit('invalid dim')
```
Run that before posting to embeddings — saved one POC already.
Marta: I'll follow up with pricing and trial request, and assign an engineering POV to help SparrowTech patch the client.
Jamie: Great — appreciate the quick swarm.
